gp180.choicePolicy: Since the source is purely acoustic, this rig simulates a highly processed, dry archtop sound using clean tones and specific EQ/compression to mimic vintage recording clarity.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A very clean signal chain utilizing compression for attack definition, followed by a low-gain, warm amp model (US Deluxe) paired with an appropriate cabinet (US 2x12). The focus is on maximizing transient response and maintaining a dry, vintage mono feel while avoiding all modern effects.

blocks.purpose: To clean up any unwanted hum or noise inherent in the recording simulation.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for vintage recordings.

blocks.purpose: To enhance the attack and sustain of the plucked strings, mimicking close-miking techniques used on acoustic instruments.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is general; specific acoustic compression modeling would be ideal but unavailable.

blocks.purpose: To boost the high-end clarity and definition (treble) crucial for fast fingerpicking, while slightly rounding out the low end.
blocks.gap: A dedicated acoustic EQ would be better, but Guitar EQ 1 provides necessary tonal shaping.

blocks.purpose: To ensure zero drive or distortion is introduced, maintaining the pure acoustic tone.
blocks.gap: N/A. Must be bypassed entirely.

blocks.purpose: To provide a clean, warm, and vintage-sounding amplification platform suitable for acoustic simulation.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is an electric amp model; it will require careful EQing to sound non-electric.

blocks.purpose: To simulate the close-miking environment of a vintage studio recording and provide a focused, non-boomy sound.
blocks.gap: A dedicated acoustic cabinet IR would be ideal, but US 2x12 is the best clean/vintage option available.

blocks.purpose: All modulation and ambience effects (Reverb, Delay) must be bypassed to achieve the dry 1930s studio feel.
blocks.gap: N/A. All modules in this category are disabled.

blocks.purpose: To set the overall output level to match the dynamic range of a recorded acoustic performance.
blocks.gap: None. Standard final stage control.

warnings: The GP-180 is an electric guitar modeler and cannot authentically recreate the pure, unamplified sound of a Selmer-Maccaferri archtop. This rig uses clean tones and heavy EQ/Compression to simulate the required clarity and vintage dry recording aesthetic.
All reverb, delay, and distortion modules are explicitly bypassed or set to 'None' as per the musical verdict.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic US 2x12 IR with a specialized acoustic cabinet simulation to better capture the dry, vintage archtop tone.

proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is too generic; a dedicated acoustic IR will improve the dry, vintage archtop character.
